note: Confirmation numbers, PINs, host phone numbers and anything to do with what this costs are deliberately NOT in this repo. Coordinates were geocoded via Nominatim; 'street' precision means the house number could not be resolved.

stays.name: IntercityHotel Rostock
stays.blurb: A functional first night, two minutes from the platform we arrive on. The point of this one is the Altstadt and the Stadthafen, not the room.

stays.name: Strandburg
stays.blurb: Our base for the Darß. Three nights, a kitchen, and the Nationalpark Vorpommersche Boddenlandschaft on the doorstep — the longest stop of the trip and the one to actually settle into.
stays.keys: Keys are in an on-site lockbox.
warnings: Third floor, stairs only — pack accordingly.
Last big supermarkets are in Barth, on the way in.

stays.name: IFA Rügen Hotel & Ferienpark
stays.room: Studio with Extra Bed — entire studio
stays.blurb: Deliberately one night and deliberately short. We check in at 17:00, go straight out to the beach bars on the Strandpromenade, and nobody plans anything for the following morning.
warnings: Only 17 hours here, most of them after dark. Do not schedule a sunrise.
Binz parking is paid and strictly enforced — check the hotel arrangement.

stays.name: Hausboot "Seeadler"
stays.blurb: The extravagant bit. A moored houseboat in Stralsund harbour with a sauna and a roof terrace, two minutes from a UNESCO Altstadt. Comfortably the best idea on the whole itinerary.
stays.keys: Keys in an on-site lockbox — the box hangs visibly on the left harbour gate. The host sends the code in advance.
warnings: If the lockbox code has not arrived by 3 September, chase the host.

stays.name: Hotel Am Hopfenmarkt
highlights: Short walk to the car return
stays.blurb: Last night, back where we started, in the Altstadt rather than by the station. Drop the car at Enterprise on the Warnowufer before they shut at 18:00 and Tuesday morning becomes trivial.
warnings: Check-in closes at 18:00 — the tightest window of the trip.
Returning the car on Monday evening means no hotel garage to find at all.
